from collections import Counter
def parse(k):
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']

import itertools
def intersect_matrix(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hrows=[i for i in range(H) if Counter(g[i]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    gv=[[g[i][j] for i in range(H)] for j in range(W)]
    vcols=[j for j in range(W) if Counter(gv[j]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    lc=Counter([g[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    M={}
    for a in range(len(hrows)-1):
        for b in range(len(vcols)-1):
            cs=[g[hrows[a]][vcols[b]],g[hrows[a]][vcols[b+1]],
                g[hrows[a+1]][vcols[b]],g[hrows[a+1]][vcols[b+1]]]
            u={c for c in cs if c not in (fill,lc)}
            if len(u)==1: M[(a,b)]=list(u)[0]
            else: M[(a,b)]=None
    return M,len(hrows)-1,len(vcols)-1,fill,lc,hrows,vcols
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    M,th,tw,fill,lc,hrows,vcols=intersect_matrix(g)
    print('==',k,'matrix',[[M.get((a,b),None) for b in range(tw)] for a in range(th)],'| out',o)

def info(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # line color: color forming full rows/cols; take second-most-common overall as heuristic fallback
    lc2=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(2)[1][0]
    hrows=[i for i in range(H) if Counter(g[i]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    gv=[[g[i][j] for i in range(H)] for j in range(W)]
    vcols=[j for j in range(W) if Counter(gv[j]).most_common(1)[0][0]!=fill]
    return fill,hrows,vcols,lc2
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    fill,hrows,vcols,lc=info(g)
    print(k,'fill',fill,'lc',lc,'nhr',len(hrows),'nvc',len(vcols),'out',(len(o),len(o[0])))

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def analyze(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]!=fill for j in range(W))]
    vc=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]!=fill for i in range(H))]
    return fill,hr,vc
def f(g):
    fill,hr,vc=analyze(g)
    lc=g[hr[0]][vc[0]]
    M=[[g[hr[a]][vc[b]] for b in range(len(vc))] for a in range(len(hr))]
    # tile (a,b) colored c if >=3 corners == c
    grid=[]
    colcells=[]
    for a in range(len(M)-1):
        row=[]
        for b in range(len(M[0])-1):
            cs=[M[a][b],M[a+1][b],M[a][b+1],M[a+1][b+1]]
            c=Counter(cs).most_common()
            best=max(c,key=lambda t:t[1])
            row.append(best[0] if best[1]>=3 else fill)
            if best[1]>=3: colcells.append((a,b))
        grid.append(row)
    if colcells:
        rs=[t[0] for t in colcells]; cs=[t[1] for t in colcells]
        return [[grid[r][c] for c in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
    return grid
for k in ['Demo pair '+str(i) for i in range(1,8)]:
    p=f(G[k+' input']); o=G[k+' output']

import itertools
def analyze(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]!=fill for j in range(W))]
    vc=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]!=fill for i in range(H))]
    return fill,hr,vc
# Build per-demo feature table: for each tile, count of each color at corners, and whether tile is colored in output
data=[]
for k in ['Demo pair '+str(i) for i in range(1,8)]:
    g=G[k+' input']; o=G[k+' output']
    fill,hr,vc=analyze(g)
    lc=g[hr[0]][vc[0]]
    M=[[g[hr[a]][vc[b]] for b in range(len(vc))] for a in range(len(hr))]
    info={'k':k,'fill':fill,'lc':lc,'M':M,'o':o}
    data.append(info)
for d in data:
    o=d['o']; M=d['M']
    for a in range(len(M)-1):
        for b in range(len(M[0])-1):
            cs=[M[a][b],M[a+1][b],M[a][b+1],M[a+1][b+1]]
            c=Counter(cs)
            info=d
            info['tile_%d_%d'% (a,b)]=(cs,c,o[a][b])
    print(d['k'],d['fill'],d['lc'])
